findings.description: The 'data' bucket sets no ACL and has no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block, and the inline comment states the bucket is public. It holds a customer master spreadsheet, so anonymous readers could retrieve sensitive customer data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects including customer-master.xlsx are stored without enforced SSE-KMS/SSE-S3 encryption.
No logging block is configured on a bucket that is intended to be public, so unauthorised object access leaves no audit trail for detection or forensics.

A customer master data file is uploaded into aws_s3_bucket.data, which is public and unencrypted, and the object itself specifies no kms_key_id or server_side_encryption, directly exposing sensitive customer records.
The financials bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving financial records stored without enforced encryption at rest.
No logging block is defined for this bucket holding financial data, so access to it is not auditable.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is set, so operations data is stored without enforced server-side encryption.
No logging block is configured, so access to this bucket produces no audit trail.
The data science bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so its contents (commonly derived from production datasets) are unencrypted at rest.

No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource is defined for this bucket, so ACLs and bucket policies granting anonymous or cross-account access are not blocked - the primary control that would mitigate the intended-public configuration is absent.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is associated with this bucket, so a future ACL or policy change could expose financial records publicly with no account guardrail in place.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is associated with this bucket, so nothing prevents a later ACL or bucket policy from granting public access.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is associated with this bucket, so nothing prevents a later ACL or bucket policy from granting public access.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is associated with the log bucket, so a future ACL or bucket policy change could expose access logs publicly.
No bucket policy denies requests where aws:SecureTransport is false, so objects in this public bucket can be read and written over plaintext HTTP.
No bucket policy enforces aws:SecureTransport, permitting financial data to be transferred over unencrypted HTTP.
No bucket policy enforces aws:SecureTransport, permitting object transfer over unencrypted HTTP.
No bucket policy enforces aws:SecureTransport, permitting object transfer over unencrypted HTTP.
No bucket policy enforces aws:SecureTransport on the log bucket, permitting log data to be retrieved over unencrypted HTTP.
